newsitem.title: USA: US OPTIONS FOCUS/Tech stock options again feature.
newsitem.headline: US OPTIONS FOCUS/Tech stock options again feature.

text.p: Options on technology stocks were once again the featured play as some of the stocks, hard hit on Monday, attempted to recover lost ground, traders said Tuesday.
Intel Corp call options were the main highlight, taking eight of the 10 most active call positions on the American Stock Exchange.
Intel shares rose 2-3/4 to 130 after dropping more than five points Monday.
Activity was led by the December 130 call, which traded more than 7,100 contracts. The option expires Friday.
Traders said investors remained bullish on Intel, snapping up calls in the January series and rolling expiring December positions out.
Some, however, were selling calls to take profits.
Intel shares in early December were trading around 125 before they rocketed up to about 141 intraday last Thursday.
Busy Intel puts included the December 125 and December 130.
Another recent favorite among options investors, Micron Technology Inc, continued to see heavy flows, tradres said.
Micron shares were unable to recover from their recent selloff and lost 2-5/8 to 32-1/8 on consolidated volume of nearly 10 million shares.
Micron fell after reporting fiscal first quarter earnings late Monday of $0.10 a share, including a gain of $0.03 per diluted share, down from $1.51 a year ago.
The company said profits were hurt by "significantly lower pricing" for memory chips.
Among the options, the December 35 call, in danger of expiring worthless, traded nearly 11,000 contracts. It fell 11/16 to 3/16.
Last Friday the stock was above 35.
Traders said volatility in Micron eased after being pumped up ahead of the company earnings, action typically seen among individual options.

On the Chicago Board Options Exchange, International Business Machines Corp options drew strong interest, led by the December 155 call, which traded nearly 4,600 contracts. The option rose 7/16 to 13/16.
IBM shares were among those recovering. They closed at 151-7/8, up 3-1/4. IBM has fallen from a nine-year high of 166 reached December 3.
Other active IBM options included the December 150 and 160 calls, the December 145 and 150 puts, and the January 150 and 160 calls.
